plasmo_voice.description: Proximity voice for Plasmo Voice 2.1 servers. Hold the talk key to transmit.
plasmo_voice.preview_hint: Only you can hear this. Nothing is sent to the server.
plasmo_voice.activation_hint: Voice activation: 300 ms release to preserve word endings
plasmo_voice.binding_hint: Click a binding, then press a key. Esc cancels.
plasmo_voice.hint_noise_suppression:
RNNoise noise suppression

Uses neural networks. Works well, but may increase CPU usage.

Applies to your microphone.
plasmo_voice.hint_stereo_capture: Captures stereo audio, then converts it to mono. May improve quality, but makes the sound quieter.
plasmo_voice.hint_disable_input:
Completely disables the use of any microphone in the operating system.

This is useful when you need to disable the use of the microphone for stereo mode in bluetooth headphones.
plasmo_voice.hint_sound_occlusion: Traces a ray from the player to each audio source and muffles it when the ray passes through blocks.
plasmo_voice.hint_directional_sources:
Makes a source quieter when it is pointing away from you and outside the selected angle.

Applies to the players you hear.
plasmo_voice.hint_hrtf:
Improves audio positioning in 3D space.

May reduce sound quality.

Applies to the players you hear.
plasmo_voice.hint_directional_angle: The angle within which a directional source is heard at 100% volume. At 360 degrees, directionality has no effect.
plasmo_voice.hint_mono_sources:
Add-ons can use stereo sources for better audio quality, without positional panning.

When enabled, stereo sources are converted to mono and gain positional panning.
plasmo_voice.hint_source_overlap:
Resolves overlaps when a player has both proximity and direct sources active

- Mute Direct: mutes direct sources when proximity is active
- Mute Proximity: mutes proximity sources when direct is active
- Off: no overlap resolution
plasmo_voice.hint_adaptive_jitter:
Time-based network jitter buffer with adaptive delay depending on connection quality

Try to enable this option if you hear audio artifacts caused by bad connection.
plasmo_voice.runtime_unsupported_target: Voice is disabled on this platform. This version supports Linux x86_64 GNU and Windows x64 GNU. The game and other mods remain available.
plasmo_voice.runtime_missing_cmake: Voice is disabled because CMake was not found. Install CMake on PATH, then press Reconnect voice. Restart the launcher if its PATH changed.
plasmo_voice.runtime_missing_ninja: Voice is disabled because Ninja was not found. Install Ninja on PATH, then press Reconnect voice. Restart the launcher if its PATH changed.
plasmo_voice.runtime_missing_compiler: Voice is disabled because a C/C++ compiler is unavailable. Install the build tools, then press Reconnect voice.
plasmo_voice.runtime_build_failed: Audio preparation failed. Check .plasmo_voice/audio/ for audio-build.log, then press Reconnect voice to retry.
plasmo_voice.runtime_source_integrity: Voice is disabled because an audio source archive failed its integrity check. Download the mod again and rebuild the instance.
plasmo_voice.runtime_preparing: Preparing verified audio libraries in the background. First preparation needs CMake and C/C++; Windows also needs Ninja. Later starts reuse the local cache.
